name: The Still Dancer
source:
A broken wind-up ballerina in a music box tries to regain her memory with the help of a small child.

[From [url=https://moreteethplease.itch.io/the-still-dancer]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
音乐盒中，一只损坏的发条芭蕾舞人偶，试图在一个小孩子的帮助下找回记忆。

[摘自[url=https://moreteethplease.itch.io/the-still-dancer]Itch.io[/url]]
